blocks.text: Three failure families produce misleading messages: wrong-architecture binaries, Windows line endings in scripts, and executables that are missing or not executable.

rows: arm64 image on amd64 (or reverse); script without shebang
`exec /entrypoint.sh: no such file or directory` (file exists)
venv not on PATH; installed in builder only

blocks.text:
$ docker image inspect -f '{{.Architecture}}' ghcr.io/acme/rag-api:1.4.2 ; uname -m
arm64
x86_64
$ docker run --rm --entrypoint cat rag-api -A /entrypoint.sh | head -1
#!/bin/sh^M$

Q: "exec format error on the server, works on your Mac. Why?" A: "The image was built for linux/arm64 on Apple Silicon and the server is amd64. Build in CI with --platform linux/amd64 or multi-arch, and confirm with docker image inspect."

items: exec format error → architecture (or missing shebang).
"No such file" for a present script → CRLF.
Fix line endings in git, not at runtime.
